resources.string: Ask your company for an invitation linked to your email. New accounts are registered as workers.
Use 12–64 characters and at most 64 UTF-8 bytes. Name: up to 120 characters.
Phone: 7–32 characters, digits, optional leading +, spaces, () . or -. Leaving it blank keeps the current number.
Logout revokes this session on the server. A connection is required; if it fails, retry.
Account created. Log in with your credentials.
Check the email, name, invitation and password or phone limits.

Your account does not have permission for this action.
